risks.mitigationActions: Continuous compliance monitoring

risks.mitigationActions: Access reviews and DLP tuning
risks.treatmentActions: Access reviews and DLP tuning

risks.title: Third Party Security Breach
risks.description: Vendor compromise affecting bank data
risks.mitigationActions: Annual vendor reassessment
risks.treatmentActions: Annual vendor reassessment

risks.title: Backup and Recovery Failure
risks.description: Inability to restore critical systems after an incident
risks.mitigationActions: Quarterly restoration testing
risks.treatmentActions: Quarterly restoration testing

risks.title: Insider Threat Activity
risks.description: Employees misuse authorized access
risks.mitigationActions: User behavior analytics deployment

risks.description: Attackers exploit known vulnerabilities
risks.mitigationActions: Weekly vulnerability scans
risks.treatmentActions: Weekly vulnerability scans

risks.title: Incident Response Failure
risks.description: Security incidents are not contained in a timely manner
risks.mitigationActions: Conduct tabletop exercises every quarter
risks.treatmentActions: Conduct tabletop exercises every quarter

risks.title: Absence of Multi-Factor Authentication
risks.description: Attackers may gain unauthorized access using stolen credentials.
risks.mitigationActions: Enforce MFA for all users.
risks.treatmentActions: Enforce MFA for all users.

risks.title: Failure to Detect Security Incidents
risks.description: Security events may remain unnoticed due to insufficient monitoring.
risks.mitigationActions: Enable centralized logging and alert tuning.
risks.treatmentActions: Enable centralized logging and alert tuning.

risks.title: Improper Data Retention Management
risks.description: Failure to retain or dispose of data according to regulations.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement retention and disposal procedures.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement retention and disposal procedures.

risks.title: Business Continuity Failure
risks.description: Critical services may not recover after a major disruption.
risks.mitigationActions: Perform annual DR testing.
risks.treatmentActions: Perform annual DR testing.

risks.title: Unauthorized System Changes
risks.description: Unapproved changes may disrupt business services.
risks.mitigationActions: Enforce change approval workflow.
risks.treatmentActions: Enforce change approval workflow.

risks.title: Database Security Misconfiguration
risks.description: Sensitive data may become accessible due to incorrect settings.
risks.mitigationActions: Quarterly database configuration review.
risks.treatmentActions: Quarterly database configuration review.

risks.title: Misuse of Privileged Accounts
risks.description: Administrative accounts may be abused intentionally or accidentally.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement PAM solution.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement PAM solution.

risks.title: Delayed Vulnerability Remediation
risks.description: Known vulnerabilities remain exposed for extended periods.
risks.mitigationActions: Weekly remediation tracking.
risks.treatmentActions: Weekly remediation tracking.

risks.title: Insufficient Security Awareness
risks.description: Employees may fall victim to social engineering attacks.
risks.mitigationActions: Conduct quarterly awareness campaigns.
risks.treatmentActions: Conduct quarterly awareness campaigns.

risks.title: Third Party Data Exposure
risks.description: Customer data may be exposed through a compromised vendor.
risks.mitigationActions: Annual vendor security audit and continuous monitoring.
risks.treatmentActions: Annual vendor security audit and continuous monitoring.

risks.title: Cloud Security Misconfiguration
risks.description: Sensitive customer and banking data may be exposed due to improperly configured cloud resources such as public storage buckets or databases.
risks.mitigationActions: Deploy CSPM, perform cloud configuration reviews, enforce least privilege.
risks.treatmentActions: Deploy CSPM, perform cloud configuration reviews, enforce least privilege.

risks.title: AI Model Data Exposure
risks.description: Employees may unintentionally expose sensitive customer information while using public AI tools.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement AI governance policy, DLP controls and employee awareness.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement AI governance policy, DLP controls and employee awareness.

risks.title: Physical Security Breach – Data Center
risks.description: Unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to critical banking infrastructure, resulting in theft, sabotage or service disruption.

risks.title: ATM Skimming Attack
risks.description: Criminals may install skimming devices on ATMs to capture card information and PINs.
risks.mitigationActions: Install anti-skimming devices and increase ATM inspections.
risks.treatmentActions: Install anti-skimming devices and increase ATM inspections.

risks.title: API Security Breach
risks.description: Attackers may exploit insecure APIs to gain unauthorized access to customer data and banking services.
risks.vulnerability: No API Gateway and Rate Limiting
risks.mitigationActions: Deploy API Gateway, WAF, API monitoring and rate limiting controls.
risks.treatmentActions: Deploy API Gateway, WAF, API monitoring and rate limiting controls.

risks.title: Software Supply Chain Attack
risks.description: Malicious code may be introduced into banking applications through compromised open-source libraries or third-party software components.
risks.mitigationActions: Deploy SCA tools, vendor security validation, dependency scanning.
risks.treatmentActions: Deploy SCA tools, vendor security validation, dependency scanning.

risks.title: Mobile Banking Application Vulnerability
risks.description: Attackers may reverse engineer the banking application to extract secrets, API keys, or bypass security controls.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement code obfuscation, root detection, anti-tampering controls.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement code obfuscation, root detection, anti-tampering controls.

risks.title: Vishing Attack
risks.description: Attackers may impersonate IT support, management, or trusted parties to obtain credentials or sensitive information.
risks.vulnerability: No Verification Procedure for Phone Requests
risks.mitigationActions: Implement call verification procedures and regular vishing simulations.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement call verification procedures and regular vishing simulations.

risks.title: Data Residency Violation
risks.description: Banking or customer data may be stored outside Egypt in violation of applicable laws and regulations.
risks.mitigationActions: Continuous data residency monitoring and cloud region validation.
risks.treatmentActions: Continuous data residency monitoring and cloud region validation.

risks.title: Credential Stuffing Attack
risks.description: Attackers may use leaked credentials from other services to gain unauthorized access to customer accounts.
risks.vulnerability: Password Reuse and Weak Authentication Controls
risks.mitigationActions: Enforce MFA, password blacklist, account lockout, and rate limiting.
risks.treatmentActions: Enforce MFA, password blacklist, account lockout, and rate limiting.

risks.title: Failure to Report PDPL Breach within 72 Hours
risks.description: Failure to notify the Personal Data Protection Center within the required timeframe may result in penalties and legal action.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement automated breach notification workflow and escalation procedures.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement automated breach notification workflow and escalation procedures.

risks.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Without PDPC License
risks.description: Personal data may be transferred outside Egypt without required regulatory approval.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement data residency monitoring and transfer approval workflows.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement data residency monitoring and transfer approval workflows.

risks.title: Failure to Meet NIS2 Equivalent Security Baseline
risks.description: Security controls may not meet international cybersecurity requirements, resulting in compliance gaps.
risks.mitigationActions: Conduct NIS2 gap assessment and formal compliance program.
risks.treatmentActions: Conduct NIS2 gap assessment and formal compliance program.

risks.title: ICT Supply Chain Dependency
risks.description: Excessive reliance on a single cloud provider may cause significant operational disruption if the provider becomes unavailable.
risks.mitigationActions: Develop multi-cloud strategy and alternative vendor plans.
risks.treatmentActions: Develop multi-cloud strategy and alternative vendor plans.

risks.title: Failure to Conduct Digital Operational Resilience Testing
risks.description: Critical systems may fail during major incidents due to insufficient resilience testing.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement quarterly resilience exercises and threat-led testing.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement quarterly resilience exercises and threat-led testing.

risks.title: Deepfake-Based Social Engineering Attack
risks.description: Attackers may use AI-generated voice or video impersonation of executives to trick employees into transferring funds or disclosing sensitive information.
risks.vulnerability: No Verification Procedure for High-Risk Requests
risks.mitigationActions: Implement callback verification procedures and deepfake awareness training.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement callback verification procedures and deepfake awareness training.

risks.title: Mobile Banking Trojan Infection
risks.description: Malware installed on customer devices may intercept banking credentials and OTP codes.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement RASP, anti-tampering, and root/jailbreak detection.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement RASP, anti-tampering, and root/jailbreak detection.

risks.title: DPO Not Formally Appointed or Registered
risks.description: Failure to appoint and register a Data Protection Officer may result in non-compliance with privacy regulations.
risks.mitigationActions: Appoint and register DPO and establish governance procedures.
risks.treatmentActions: Appoint and register DPO and establish governance procedures.

risks.title: Lack of Records of Processing Activities (ROPA)
risks.description: The organization may fail to demonstrate compliance due to missing records of personal data processing activities.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement automated data discovery and maintain ROPA records within GRC platform.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement automated data discovery and maintain ROPA records within GRC platform.

risks.title: Account Takeover via SIM Swap Attack
risks.description: Attackers may gain control of customer accounts by hijacking phone numbers used for SMS-based authentication.
risks.vulnerability: Reliance on SMS OTP as Sole Authentication Factor
risks.mitigationActions: Implement authenticator-based MFA, biometric authentication and SIM swap detection controls.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement authenticator-based MFA, biometric authentication and SIM swap detection controls.

risks.title: Failure to Submit DPIA for High-Risk Processing
risks.description: High-risk personal data processing activities may be implemented without conducting a Data Protection Impact Assessment, resulting in regulatory violations.
risks.mitigationActions: Formalize DPIA process and integrate with project lifecycle.
risks.treatmentActions: Formalize DPIA process and integrate with project lifecycle.

risks.title: Insufficient Network Segmentation
risks.description: Attackers may move laterally across the network after an initial compromise due to insufficient segmentation between critical systems.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement micro-segmentation and zero-trust network architecture.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement micro-segmentation and zero-trust network architecture.

risks.title: ICT Incident Reporting Delay
risks.description: Critical cybersecurity incidents may not be reported within regulatory timelines due to inefficient reporting processes.
risks.mitigationActions: Automate incident notification and reporting workflows.
risks.treatmentActions: Automate incident notification and reporting workflows.

risks.title: Supply Chain Security Assessment Failure
risks.description: Critical vendors may introduce cybersecurity risks due to insufficient security assessments and monitoring.
risks.vulnerability: No Formal Vendor Security Assessment Program
risks.mitigationActions: Establish vendor security assessment framework and periodic audits.
risks.treatmentActions: Establish vendor security assessment framework and periodic audits.

risks.title: Insider Threat Detection Failure
risks.description: Malicious or negligent employees may access or exfiltrate sensitive information without detection.
risks.mitigationActions: Deploy UEBA and DLP solutions with continuous monitoring.
risks.treatmentActions: Deploy UEBA and DLP solutions with continuous monitoring.

risks.title: Compliance Mapping Failure
risks.description: Incorrect mapping between regulations and controls may lead to inaccurate compliance reports and audit findings.
risks.escalationPath: Board of Directors via Regulatory Risk Register
risks.mitigationActions: Automated mapping validation and periodic compliance reviews.
risks.treatmentActions: Automated mapping validation and periodic compliance reviews.

risks.title: Automated Evidence Collection Failure
risks.description: Automated evidence collection processes may fail, resulting in incomplete audit evidence and compliance gaps.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement workflow health monitoring, alerting, and failover mechanisms.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement workflow health monitoring, alerting, and failover mechanisms.

risks.title: Risk Heatmap Inaccuracy
risks.description: Risk calculations may be inaccurate due to incorrect formulas or scoring logic, leading to poor management decisions.
risks.mitigationActions: Implement automated validation checks and independent risk model reviews.
risks.treatmentActions: Implement automated validation checks and independent risk model reviews.
